items: We have used the get_average_score() function to first calculate the average score.
Then, we passed the average score as an argument to the compute_grade() function to compute the grade.

blocks.content: In this program, we have provided student scores directly at the beginning.
We can make this program dynamic by getting marks input from the user.
I suggest you try that on your own.
Tip: Use a for loop and cin to get input scores and based on the input find the average score and grade.
